'''Bay 14''' was a loading bay located in the [[Hedrett Public Transport Facility]] which was in the [[Hedrett warehouse district]] of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Hedrett]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gadrin]].
